headline: The blue seat learns to signal
lede: Walnuts Street's partner now tells you everything at phone scale: a rescue arrives in chevrons, a freed grip blinks the HUD, the KO strut walks its swagger, knockdowns land with weight — and the jab finally sits clear of the pickup chime.

notes.text: #2889 shipped all five of QA's guardian-read items for DOUBLE DRAGON — every one render-side, stateHash untouched, 18 new pins and mutants between them.

The guardian's speed-dashes became chevrons (3x5 px marks that survive dock zoom, trail deeper so a clipped screen edge keeps the promise); the KO pose borrowed the arcade's step-back — a five-pixel drift under the strut that eases out and home with zero snap; knockdowns flatten into the asphalt and rebound over an 8-tick beat.

The squash was sized by frame pacing, not taste: on a loaded box a two-tick impact got stepped over whole between paints — the same trap #2897 named for flashes. Eight ticks is the proven paint-survivable width, and the easing reads better anyway.

The blue seat's jab kept its F#4 identity but left the square for a triangle: its third harmonic sat 2 Hz off the pickup chime's middle note — on a phone speaker, punches and rewards buzzed as one. Now ~9.5 dB lower: separation by arithmetic, snap kept by a fatter noise transient.
